description: The FAIRiCUBE project provides a Vienna tree-cover-density raster for the 2018 reference year. Its Zenodo description says the layer was reprojected from the Copernicus Land Monitoring Service Tree Cover Density 2018 product to EPSG:31256. Values represent zero to 100 percent cover in 100-metre cells, and one public Cloud Optimized GeoTIFF is listed under CC BY 4.0. Urban vegetation cover can inform shade, runoff or heat-exposure simulations around transport corridors and public spaces. The layer is a land-cover fraction, not tree species, canopy height or current planting condition. Resampling and source classification errors can affect small sites. CLMS is the upstream source and its rights remain separate from this Zenodo licence label. No related catalogue record explicitly covers the Vienna extraction. The raster was not downloaded; its projection and pixel percentages were not checked from file contents.
name: Vienna tree cover density 2018 (100m)
